Dear Miss Yonge,
How do you like the enclosed pages & title page? Will you kindly consult [Miss Sewell](/person/1301), the first title was her suggestion.[^1] [I](/person/939) am [illegible]
home at the [illegible]
Yours very truly
A. Macmillan


[^1]: This relates to the choice of title for the anthology of historical writing edited by CMY and Elizabeth Sewell, eventually published as [Historical Selections: A Series of Readings from the Best Authorities in English and European History](/book/71).
